# Women In Tools

ATG is a great place for women to build a dynamic career.  With professional development and
opportunities to grow, the potential is a click away.

[Learn More][63]
 
 

# Join Our Team

ATG is a lean, innovative and inclusive team where every idea counts. Your creativity, passion and
know-how can accelerate our success. Join us to build the career you’ve always wanted.

[Learn More][64]
 
 

# Electronics

We make the tools needed to support the design, testing, manufacturing and repair of the latest
electronics innovations -- from smart phones and tablets to video game consoles and e-readers.

[Learn More][65]
 
 

# Construction / DIY

We provide contractors with durable and dependable tools for material handling, framing, surveying,
inspecting, and many build/rebuild tasks.

[Learn More][66]
 
 

# Motor Vehicle Industry

We provide the fastening solutions global motor vehicle manufacturers need to ensure superior
quality production.

[Learn More][67]
 
 

# Industrial

With a reputation dating back more than 100 years, we provide tools and equipment for preventative
machine maintenance, production, and parts assembly at the most demanding industrial facilities and
production and parts assembly at manufacturing plants around the globe.

[Learn More][68]
 
 

# Vehicle Service

We offer a wide array of professional hand and power tools to the global service industry. In this
market that relies largely on manual labor, we know that time is money.

[Learn More][69]
 
 

# Aerospace

Built with the stringent standards of the aerospace technician in mind, our tools improve
productivity and ensure strength and precision during the assembly process.

[Learn More][70]
 

# ATG’s Master Brands

Apex Tool Group manufactures leading hand and power tool brands around the world.

# Kurtz Ersa - GLOBAL. AHEAD. SUSTAINABLE.

We are a globally active mechanical engineering company based in Spessart, Germany, founded in 1779
and owner-managed in the seventh generation. As a technology and market leader in the fields of
electronics production equipment, moulding machines and automation, we optimize our customers'
manufacturing processes. Thanks to our global footprint, we realize innovative solutions worldwide
with only one goal in mind: the highest quality for our customers! We are an attractive employer in
the region and offer our employees a wide range of training opportunities through our in-house
academy. For us, sustainability not only means protecting the environment, but also long-term
partnerships with our business partners and a high level of reliability in what we do every day. For

# Kurtz Ersa - GLOBAL. AHEAD. SUSTAINABLE.

We are a globally active mechanical engineering company based in Spessart, Germany, founded in 1779
and owner-managed in the seventh generation. As a technology and market leader in the fields of
electronics production equipment, moulding machines and automation, we optimize our customers'
manufacturing processes. Thanks to our global footprint, we realize innovative solutions worldwide
with only one goal in mind: the highest quality for our customers! We are an attractive employer in
the region and offer our employees a wide range of training opportunities through our in-house
academy. For us, sustainability not only means protecting the environment, but also long-term
partnerships with our business partners and a high level of reliability in what we do every day. For
our 250th anniversary in 2029, we are aiming to be CO2-neutral.*

*Related to Scope 1 and Scope 2 and partially Scope 3 emissions.

# Technitool, Inc.

Since our beginning in 1975, our philosophy has been to build a quality product. We feel that our
name is our reputation. In an industry as tightly knit as plastics, you must consistently build an
excellent quality mold to continue to grow as we have.

We are very proud of the fact that over the decades we have been in business, we have retained many
of the customers that we've had since the beginning.

A business is more than just steel and design, it's people. We have built our company on the theory
that you should treat people as you would like to be treated, and this has worked very well for us.

We believe that our company is more service than manufacturing. Technitool is small enough to know
you, but large enough to provide excellent service.

When producing a quality mold, people are the key, and we have the key people. We listen and we
understand what it means when you say that time to market is critical. We will guide you in choosing
the molding process and material for maximum quality and value. We can help solve problems by
finding new and better ways of molding plastic parts. Responding to your needs in a timely fashion
is what the expert staff at Technitool does best.

that you should treat people as you would like to be treated, and this has worked very well for us.

We believe that our company is more service than manufacturing. Technitool is small enough to know
you, but large enough to provide excellent service.

When producing a quality mold, people are the key, and we have the key people. We listen and we
understand what it means when you say that time to market is critical. We will guide you in choosing
the molding process and material for maximum quality and value. We can help solve problems by
finding new and better ways of molding plastic parts. Responding to your needs in a timely fashion
is what the expert staff at Technitool does best.

# Women In Tools

ATG is a great place for women to build a dynamic career.  With professional development and
opportunities to grow, the potential is a click away.

ATG is a lean, innovative and inclusive team where every idea counts. Your creativity, passion and
know-how can accelerate our success. Join us to build the career you’ve always wanted.

# Electronics

We make the tools needed to support the design, testing, manufacturing and repair of the latest
electronics innovations -- from smart phones and tablets to video game consoles and e-readers.

[Learn More][65]
 
 

# Construction / DIY

We provide contractors with durable and dependable tools for material handling, framing, surveying,
inspecting, and many build/rebuild tasks.

[Learn More][66]
 
 

# Motor Vehicle Industry

We provide the fastening solutions global motor vehicle manufacturers need to ensure superior
quality production.

[Learn More][67]
 
 

# Industrial

With a reputation dating back more than 100 years, we provide tools and equipment for preventative
machine maintenance, production, and parts assembly at the most demanding industrial facilities and
production and parts assembly at manufacturing plants around the globe.

# Vehicle Service

We offer a wide array of professional hand and power tools to the global service industry. In this
market that relies largely on manual labor, we know that time is money.

# Aerospace

Built with the stringent standards of the aerospace technician in mind, our tools improve
productivity and ensure strength and precision during the assembly process.

## Instant and Automated Quotes and Ordering with InstantDFM™

Quickly and easily order your customized PCB with [InstantDFM][41]™. Discover how the tool works and
how easy it is to place an order using the process outlined below. InstantDFM™ is a web-based tool
that provides customized, quick-turn printed circuit board pricing within minutes.

### UPLOAD

Upload your files, answer a couple of questions, and receive your InstantDFM™ report.



### CUSTOMIZE

Examine your DFM report and make customizations to materials, surface finishes and other
manufacturing specifications.



### ORDER

Review your quote, customizations, and place your order. It’s that easy!

printing results and advises you of process-related issues for your solder paste printing, placement
of adhesive points and special applications. Alongside our SMT stencil range, we also produce wafer
and LTCC stencils.

In addition to our comprehensive technical advice, we offer a standard delivery time of one day for
almost all products - and that is without extra charges or express surcharges. We see ourselves as
partners of our customers - count on our technical know-how as well as more than 30 years of
experience!

We respond to you swiftly - regardless of production or support inquiries.

processes with high-tech SMD stencils tailored to your individual needs.

Benefit from our many years of technical know-how.

## About Us

   Brightlaser was founded in 2014, is a global pioneer supplier in VCSEL technology from
components, sensors, to total solutions for AI/IoT applications including Optical Communication,
Consumer Electronics, ADAS, Machine Vision, Telecom, Robotics, Smart House, Surveillance Systems.
As a high-tech company, Brightlaser possesses its own VCSEL intellectual properties in wafer design,
advanced chip process, and applications. Brightlaser headquartered in Hong Kong, established branch
offices in Shen Zhen and Zhong Shan of China. The factory located in Zhong Shan covers  footprint of
160,000 Sqft., equipped with globally state- of-art GaAs techniques, and the first 6-inch VCSEL
chip fab & packaging line in mainland China.

# Manufacturing That Eliminates Risk & Improves Reliability

## The Ideal Choice for an OEM Seeking Customized Product Solutions.

Epec Engineered Technologies is the ideal choice for an OEM seeking customized product solutions
from a focused and agile partner having supported over 5,000 customers across all sectors of the
electronics industry. By providing highly experienced technical resources, a proven manufacturing
platform and the fastest delivery in the industry, we are able to provide cost effective and
innovative solutions that deliver the highest reliability products to the market faster. [*Learn
more about our custom build to print products...*][85]

## Printed Circuit Boards Engineered for Performance and Reliability

Your trusted partner for custom printed circuit boards built to your specs, combining precision
manufacturing with rapid turnaround and engineering support. Whether high-volume production or
advanced prototypes, we deliver dependable PCBs that meet the demands of aerospace, medical,
industrial, and defense applications for the most critical electronics.

[Learn More][86]

## High-Performance Flex and Rigid-Flex PCB Solutions

Advanced flex & rigid-flex circuit boards designed for demanding environments and complex
assemblies. Our custom solutions deliver cost-effective performance in aerospace, medical, and
rugged applications where space, durability, and precision matter. From single- to multi-layer PCBs,
we help you optimize layouts, streamline assembly, and improve reliability in high-performance
systems.

[Learn More][87]

### 了解更多

### **香港激光矯視中心 香港首屈一指的矯視中心**

香港激光矯視中心在香港成立 25
年，一直專注為客人提供最優質的眼科及矯視服務。本矯視中心為客人提供SMILE 微笑激光矯視、LASIK
激光矯視、Mosaic PiXL
矯視等多種不同的矯視服務，有效矯正及改善各種眼睛問題。香港的生活繁忙，都市人的生活習慣容易導致各種視
力問題，香港人患上近視的比例更是全球第一，因此香港矯視的需求可以說是十分龐大。激光矯視除了可以讓人不
用再戴眼鏡之外，亦可以治療很多類型的眼睛疾病，例如青光眼及白內障，讓很多人避過失去視力的風險。香港激
光矯視中心是在香港矯視行業首屈一指的矯視中心，曾經服務客人超過十萬個，本矯視中心亦不斷引入先進的矯視
技術及設備，讓客人能夠有機會體驗最新視光科技的好處。

香港激光矯視中心成就包括:
成為完成全香港第 1 個 SMILE 矯視個案的香港矯視中心
已完成超過 110,000 個激光矯視手術個案
2019 及 2020 連續兩年榮獲 Elite Awards 頒發星級眼科矯視科技大獎
榮獲 2022 香港最優秀企業大獎
矯視中心及診所分店網絡遍布世界全球各地，包括中國、美國、歐洲、新加坡及香港


#### **香港激光矯視中心的優勢 **

香港激光矯視中心秉持持續為客人提供優質可靠的矯視服務的宗旨，我們深深地明白到每個人的視力都是至關重要
的，因此我們對矯視服務的每一個範疇都有卓越的追求。

#### **最專業的醫生團隊**

香港激光矯視中心擁有最專業的醫生團隊，所有經本中心的聘用的眼科醫生，特別是為患者進行矯視手術的醫生擁
有豐富的行業經驗及專業背景，他們在進行術前眼科檢查到激光矯視手術的每一個細節都一絲不苟，讓客人能放心
地接受矯視手術。醫生團隊的專業性對於患者矯視手術的效果有顯著的影響，我們的醫生曾經為過萬個客人提供矯
視服務，得到眾多客人的好評。  

#### **先進的矯視技術及設備 **

香港激光矯視中心確保本中心使用最新的技術和設備進行手術。現代的激光矯視技術不斷發展，先進的矯視技術及
設備能夠提供更高的精確度，大大減底矯視手術出錯的機會及縮短患者的復原時間。本中心已添置的矯視技術及設
備包括德國蔡司 Carl Zeiss VisuMax® 飛秒激光系統、美國 IntraLase FS Laser 激光切割器、德國 Wavelight
Allegretto Wave Eye-Q 激光矯視系統、德國 Schwind Amaris 750激光矯視系統、德國蔡司 Carl Zeiss
Humphrey 視野檢查分析儀及各種高分辨率 OCT 醫學成像設備等。

可以。客人可以在香港激光矯視中心進行常規的眼睛健康檢查，包括成人或兒童的眼睛檢查，以及近視控制檢查等
。

5. 激光矯視可以治療甚麼眼睛問題？
激光矯視可以治療多種不同的眼睛問題，包括近視、遠視、散光、老花等問題。

6. 在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視的流程是怎樣？
在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視前，眼科醫生會先進行詳細的眼科檢查和評估，確定患者是否適合進行激光矯視手術
。合適的患者會在手術室進行激光矯視手術，利用激光矯視技術來重塑角膜的形狀，從而改善視力。矯視手術過程
一般只需十至十五分鐘左右，完成後需要定期覆診跟進眼睛情況。

7. 香港矯視中心會進行哪些測試和檢查去評估我是否適合進行激光矯視手術？
香港矯視中心會進行一系列的測試和檢查，以確定你是否適合進行激光矯視手術。評估項目包括眼科及視力檢查、
屈光度檢測、角膜曲率測試、角膜厚度測量、瞳孔測量以及患者的身體狀況評估等。

8. 激光矯視手術的費用是多少？
激光矯視手術包括SMILE PRO、SMILE 、 LASIK及PRESBYMAX
等，因應不同的技術及方式所涉的費用會有所不同。激光矯視手術費用通常已經包括手術費用、基本藥物費用及後
續跟進的費用。你可以向本矯視中心的職員查詢有關激光矯視手術費用的詳細資料。

9. 激光矯視手術後，需要多長時間才能恢復正常視力？
激光矯視手術後的恢復時間因個人而異，但大多數人在矯視手術後的幾天內便會恢復大部分的視力。然而，完全恢
復達到最佳視力可能需要幾個星期至幾個月的時間。

10. 完成激光矯視手術後是否可以一勞永逸？
完成激光矯視手術可以長期改善視力，但不能保證一勞永逸。部分人可能會在激光矯視術後出現度數反彈，需要再
次進行增進手術，而即使沒有出現度數反彈，長期過度使用眼睛或不良習慣等仍會令遠近視及散光等眼睛問題再次
出現。

11. 甚麼人不適合接受激光矯視手術？
眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適
合接受激光矯視手術。

12. 我的健康狀況會否影響我接受激光矯視手術？
如患有某些疾病，如糖尿病、自身免疫性疾病、眼睛受傷及眼部疾病或懷孕等都可能會影響接受激光矯視。因此在
接受激光矯視前，患者會經過全面的評估及檢查，確定合適才會進行。

13. 如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，有甚麼途徑？
如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，可以經本矯視中心網站預約不同主題的講座，講座會以廣東話/英文/普通話
形式進行。

14. 如何預約香港激光矯視中心的服務？
如客人有需要預約香港激光矯視中心的服務，可以根據自己方便的位置，致電附近的矯視中心分店診所預約及查詢
詳細資料。

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# USA PCB Manufacturing & Assembly (Turnkey) | PNC Inc.

## Single-Source PCB Solution

## Complete PCB Fabrication & Assembly Services Manufacturer

 PNC Inc. is an industry-leading, single-source manufacturer of high-reliability [Printed Circuit
Boards (PCBs][232]) and [PCB Assembly][233]. Established in 1969, we proudly serve a nationwide
clientele across the United States, Canada and Mexico delivering advanced solutions for the Defense
(DoD), Aerospace, [RF][234], Medical, and Commercial sectors.

By integrating complete PCB fabrication and assembly under one roof, we eliminate supply chain
friction to offer the fastest turnaround times in the industry. PNC Inc. is fully committed to the
highest quality standards, maintaining [AS9100D][235], ISO9001:2015,[ ITAR registered PCB assembly
northeast][236], J-STD, Certified, [MBE Electronics & PCB Assembly Manufacturer][237] and IPC Class
III and UL certifications. 

Below, you will find a list of our PC board related products and services including [PCB
Design][238], PCB Manufacturing and PCB Assembly.

## Our Major PCB Services

Well Done Technology focuses on PCB reverse engineering, PCB clone, and IC unlock. Our technical
team of more than 40 people includes senior engineers with rich experience. Founded in 2008, we have
completed over 1,000 PCB engineering projects for clients worldwide, including North America,
Europe, and Southeast Asia.

## PCB Reverse Engineering Service Capabilities

Our **PCB reverse engineering service** helps recover manufacturable design data from legacy boards,
discontinued electronics, damaged samples, or products without original CAD files. The goal is not
only to copy board geometry, but also to rebuild useful engineering outputs such as schematic
diagrams, BOM information, Gerber files, netlists, and PCB layout files for repair, redesign, or
controlled production.

Europe, and Southeast Asia.

## PCB Reverse Engineering Service Capabilities

Our **PCB reverse engineering service** helps recover manufacturable design data from legacy boards,
discontinued electronics, damaged samples, or products without original CAD files. The goal is not
only to copy board geometry, but also to rebuild useful engineering outputs such as schematic
diagrams, BOM information, Gerber files, netlists, and PCB layout files for repair, redesign, or
controlled production.

**Quality checks for reverse engineered PCB files:** before delivery, files should be checked
against the physical board, component orientation, net continuity, design rules, drill data, and
manufacturing constraints. Common references include IPC-A-600 for board acceptability, IPC-6012 for
rigid PCB performance, and IPC-2221/IPC-2222 for general design guidance.

### PCB Reverse Engineering

The PCB reverse engineering services includes pcb to schematic, [gerber files][68], design layout
optimization. Our experts can guarantee to make 100% accurate pcb schematic diagrams. Many
well-known international customers have also accredited us in various aerospace manufacturing
companies or military industries.

manufacturers such as Actel, Atmel, Microchip, and STCmicro.

## Global industrial group with deep manufacturing heritage.

With over 55 years of experience, STV has grown into a global industrial group with multiple
entities across several countries. Our legacy is built on precision, repeatability, and long‑term
industrial partnerships.

## ABOUT US

Tannlin was founded on the development of the first stencil laser cutting system and has been
focused on high accuracy thin metal laser solutions ever since. Capabilities have expanded,
encompassing customised laser cutting systems, high accuracy laser processing and electronic
assembly support products. Tannlin’s ability to bring innovative solutions to the market for it’s
customers can be attributed to continuous investment in research and development, quality and
process control.

Taking advantage of emerging laser and motion technology, our aim is to create and maintain an
environment and culture which promotes innovative design and production.

 

Tannlin have a proven track record in high accuracy laser cutting covering 25 years. Through this
experience our engineering teams have developed a strong understanding of our customer’s processes
and requirements. We combine this broad range of experience across multiple industries to supply
each customer with the best solution that meets their requirements.

## ABOUT US

focused on high accuracy thin metal laser solutions ever since. Capabilities have expanded,
encompassing customised laser cutting systems, high accuracy laser processing and electronic
assembly support products. Tannlin’s ability to bring innovative solutions to the market for it’s
customers can be attributed to continuous investment in research and development, quality and
process control.

Taking advantage of emerging laser and motion technology, our aim is to create and maintain an
environment and culture which promotes innovative design and production.

 

Tannlin have a proven track record in high accuracy laser cutting covering 25 years. Through this
experience our engineering teams have developed a strong understanding of our customer’s processes
and requirements. We combine this broad range of experience across multiple industries to supply

# Manufacturing That Eliminates Risk & Improves Reliability

## The Ideal Choice for an OEM Seeking Customized Product Solutions.

Epec Engineered Technologies is the ideal choice for an OEM seeking customized product solutions
from a focused and agile partner having supported over 5,000 customers across all sectors of the
electronics industry. By providing highly experienced technical resources, a proven manufacturing
platform and the fastest delivery in the industry, we are able to provide cost effective and
innovative solutions that deliver the highest reliability products to the market faster. [*Learn
more about our custom build to print products...*][85]

## Printed Circuit Boards Engineered for Performance and Reliability

Your trusted partner for custom printed circuit boards built to your specs, combining precision
manufacturing with rapid turnaround and engineering support. Whether high-volume production or
advanced prototypes, we deliver dependable PCBs that meet the demands of aerospace, medical,
industrial, and defense applications for the most critical electronics.

[Learn More][86]

## High-Performance Flex and Rigid-Flex PCB Solutions

Advanced flex & rigid-flex circuit boards designed for demanding environments and complex
assemblies. Our custom solutions deliver cost-effective performance in aerospace, medical, and
rugged applications where space, durability, and precision matter. From single- to multi-layer PCBs,
we help you optimize layouts, streamline assembly, and improve reliability in high-performance
systems.

。合適的患者會在手術室進行激光矯視手術，利用激光矯視技術來重塑角膜的形狀，從而改善視力。矯視手術過程
一般只需十至十五分鐘左右，完成後需要定期覆診跟進眼睛情況。

7. 香港矯視中心會進行哪些測試和檢查去評估我是否適合進行激光矯視手術？
香港矯視中心會進行一系列的測試和檢查，以確定你是否適合進行激光矯視手術。評估項目包括眼科及視力檢查、
屈光度檢測、角膜曲率測試、角膜厚度測量、瞳孔測量以及患者的身體狀況評估等。

激光矯視手術後的恢復時間因個人而異，但大多數人在矯視手術後的幾天內便會恢復大部分的視力。然而，完全恢

出現。

眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適
合接受激光矯視手術。

1.香港激光矯視中心有多少間分店診所？
香港激光矯視中心在香港設有兩間分店診所，分別位於中環皇后大道中18號新世界大廈第2期9樓及尖沙咀漢口道4-
6號騏生商業中心7樓及9樓，位置十分方便。

2. 為甚麼香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇？
香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇，因為本矯視中心的眼科醫生團隊具備良好的資歷及專業的資格及經
驗，而且配備先進的眼科矯視設備及技術。香港激光矯視中心為患者提供最優質的矯視服務，經驗豐富，在香港矯
視行業中擁有良好的口碑。

3. 香港激光矯視中心可以提供甚麼類型的香港矯視服務？
香港激光矯視中心可以提供 SMILE 及 SMILE PRO 微笑矯視、LASIK 激光矯視、ICL
植入式隱形眼鏡等的香港矯視服務。

4. 香港激光矯視中心可以進行常規的眼睛健康檢查嗎？
可以。客人可以在香港激光矯視中心進行常規的眼睛健康檢查，包括成人或兒童的眼睛檢查，以及近視控制檢查等
。

5. 激光矯視可以治療甚麼眼睛問題？
激光矯視可以治療多種不同的眼睛問題，包括近視、遠視、散光、老花等問題。

6. 在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視的流程是怎樣？
在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視前，眼科醫生會先進行詳細的眼科檢查和評估，確定患者是否適合進行激光矯視手術
。合適的患者會在手術室進行激光矯視手術，利用激光矯視技術來重塑角膜的形狀，從而改善視力。矯視手術過程
一般只需十至十五分鐘左右，完成後需要定期覆診跟進眼睛情況。

7. 香港矯視中心會進行哪些測試和檢查去評估我是否適合進行激光矯視手術？
香港矯視中心會進行一系列的測試和檢查，以確定你是否適合進行激光矯視手術。評估項目包括眼科及視力檢查、
屈光度檢測、角膜曲率測試、角膜厚度測量、瞳孔測量以及患者的身體狀況評估等。

8. 激光矯視手術的費用是多少？
激光矯視手術包括SMILE PRO、SMILE 、 LASIK及PRESBYMAX
等，因應不同的技術及方式所涉的費用會有所不同。激光矯視手術費用通常已經包括手術費用、基本藥物費用及後
續跟進的費用。你可以向本矯視中心的職員查詢有關激光矯視手術費用的詳細資料。

9. 激光矯視手術後，需要多長時間才能恢復正常視力？
激光矯視手術後的恢復時間因個人而異，但大多數人在矯視手術後的幾天內便會恢復大部分的視力。然而，完全恢
復達到最佳視力可能需要幾個星期至幾個月的時間。

10. 完成激光矯視手術後是否可以一勞永逸？
完成激光矯視手術可以長期改善視力，但不能保證一勞永逸。部分人可能會在激光矯視術後出現度數反彈，需要再
次進行增進手術，而即使沒有出現度數反彈，長期過度使用眼睛或不良習慣等仍會令遠近視及散光等眼睛問題再次
出現。

11. 甚麼人不適合接受激光矯視手術？
眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適
合接受激光矯視手術。

12. 我的健康狀況會否影響我接受激光矯視手術？
如患有某些疾病，如糖尿病、自身免疫性疾病、眼睛受傷及眼部疾病或懷孕等都可能會影響接受激光矯視。因此在
接受激光矯視前，患者會經過全面的評估及檢查，確定合適才會進行。

13. 如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，有甚麼途徑？
如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，可以經本矯視中心網站預約不同主題的講座，講座會以廣東話/英文/普通話
形式進行。

14. 如何預約香港激光矯視中心的服務？
如客人有需要預約香港激光矯視中心的服務，可以根據自己方便的位置，致電附近的矯視中心分店診所預約及查詢
詳細資料。

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Why ResaLaser HK ?

After its sixteen years of popularity in Taiwan’s well-known 147 Sports Theme
Park,Resalaser is now bringing the exciting lasertag experience to Hong Kong.
The game is played with low degrees of laser lights, allowing a safe and painless,
fun and exciting combat experience. We’ve collaborated with an experienced
Amercian professional team to invent new equipment which is a 147-NSLT
system that surpassess the old style infra-red lasers.
With increasing accuracy and sense of reality, the new 147-NSLT system uses
laser lights that are highly directional and have low degrees of diffusion.


There are various game modes with different levels of intensity allowing for
a various age groups or group functions to have their own personalized
experience.
Professional strategic players are also welcome for an exciting tactical game.


ResalaserHK's first branch began to establish at Mong Kok since 2015.
And now comprises two branches at Kwun Tong and Lai Chi Kok D2 Place one
where are exceed 10,000sq ft and accomodate up to 150 guests.
We keep providing Lasertag activities along with multifunctional and creative
party areas designed for any parties, companies' events and gathering.
